basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old hobbyist from Missoula, Montana, with a keen interest in mechanical keyboards and car tuning. My day job is as a software developer, which gives me plenty of time to tinker with my keyboard setups and plan my next mods for my Celica. I'm currently single and spend most of my evenings online after work, typically between 7 PM and midnight. I enjoy exploring different tactile switches and love discussing football tactics with friends on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, which I studied at the University of Montana. Over the years, I've developed a deep interest in mechanical keyboards, initially sparked by needing a comfortable and efficient setup for coding marathons. I've self-taught much of what I know through online forums and hands-on experimentation.
